newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes down in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes down in active trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed down in active trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 601.52 from 602.95 on Tuesday.
Volume was 5.77 million dinars against 5.8 million dinars, exceptionally high for the second consecutive day in a market boosted by trade in STB and BIAT banks.
STB won 0.28 dinar in the exchange of 70,500 shares at 23.11 dinars. BIAT was down 1.95 dinars to 63.050 dinars with 11,810 shares changing hands.
Banque de Tunisie gained 1.5 dinars at 78 dinars. Airliner TUNISAIR was up 0.58 dinar to 19.98 dinars. Retail store Monoprix fell 1.43 dinar to 46.36 dinars. ($=0.98 dinar)
